messages:
Olivia: quick follow-up from the Dedicated pools RFC. We need a tiny operator <-> control-plane intent handshake to avoid surprise evictions.
Sam: saw a tenant drop during soft prewarm yesterday. Need deterministic failure semantics.
Ria: propose: control-plane POSTs an intent blob; operator must ACK accept/reject within a timebox. No ACK => apply fallback.
Ben: minimal fields: intent={target_slots, min_slots, prewarm:soft|hard, deadline_ms, fallback, contract_version}. reply={accepted,bool, provision_id, allocated_slots, est_warmup_ms, burst_budget, ttl_ms}.
Arjun: add lightweight probe and provision_ttl so control-plane can detect accepted-but-never-materialized cases and reissue.
Maya: fallback options: spill_to_burst_lane, queue_with_timeout, deny_immediately. default spill for latency-sensitive tiers.
Sam: burst lane must be rate-limited and circuit-protected to prevent noisy neighbors.
Ria: operator should emit metrics intent_ack_latency_ms and provision_outcome and return a trace_id for audit.
Ben: sample text snippet: intent:{"target_slots":4,"min_slots":2,"prewarm":"soft","deadline_ms":20000,"fallback":"spill_to_burst_lane","contract_version":"v1"} reply:{"accepted":true,"provision_id":"prv-42","allocated_slots":4,"est_warmup_ms":12000,"burst_budget":60,"ttl_ms":120000} 
Olivia: failure flow: if accepted then fails mid-warm => mark provision failed, consult fallback, optionally reissue to another operator shard with backoff. Avoid hot loops.
Ria: tests: add a sim that ACKs then kills operator to verify fallback routing + metrics. I'll add it to autoscale test-suite.
Ben: I'll draft the microcontract doc and include example timelines + CI sim steps.
Arjun: infra-bot created ticket INF-2099 for /probe endpoint and metrics plumbing.
Olivia: action items summarized: Ben=doc, Arjun+infra=probe+metrics, Sam+Ria=fallback+ttl enforcement, Ria=sim test. I'll open a follow-up PR by EOD unless anyone objects.
Sam: 👍 no objections.
Maya: looks good, thanks.
